args.name: person
args.description: The person the user is synchronizing with.

u11.description: Syncs with a person each week, takes prep notes, and discusses agenda.
steps: Create prep notes in Notion for {{person}}
u11.executor_code:
def execute(args: dict) -> str:
    calendar_result = check_calendar(args["person"])
    
    title = args.get("topic") or args.get("person", "Note")
    notes = draft_message(args["person"], calendar_result, check_notion(args["person"]))
    notion_page_id = add_notion_page(title, notes)
    
    time_str = args.get("time", "10am")
    text = f"Meeting with {args['person']} about {title} at {time_str}"
    slack_message_sent = post_slack(text)

    return f"Synced with {args['person']}, created Notion page and posted Slack message"
